9900001 - Missing Authorization Check in SAP NetWeaver AS Java (Guided Procedures)
SAP Security Note, Version: 2, Released On: 2026.11.10
Component: EP-GP   Priority: High   CVSS v3.0 Base Score: 7.4

Symptom
SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java (Guided Procedures) does not perform a necessary authorization check for an authenticated user, which can lead to escalation of privileges.

Reason and Prerequisites
A missing authorization check in a Guided Procedures service of the AS Java.
SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and SAP S/4HANA (ABAP) are not affected.

Solution
Apply the support package patches listed in "Support Packages & Patches" to the AS Java.

Workaround
Disable the Guided Procedures application in the AS Java (NWA → Operations → Start & Stop → Java Applications).

Software Components (From - To)
GP-CORE 7.50 - 7.50
SERVERCORE 7.50 - 7.50

Support Package Patches
GP-CORE 7.50   SP027   000002
GP-CORE 7.50   SP028   000001
